next: make the bus path injectable (or skip with a reason when absent); match -n/--name only as a flag token before the prompt argument and strip ' (deleted)' from the cwd readlink, each with a grader. ADDED by the T03 review (2026-10-28, recorded, not counted): (a) the older real-server tests (test_an_up_grid_with_no_readable_root…, test_on_a_real_tmux_server…) never remove their tmux sockets; (b) the argument loop stops at the repo, so a flag after it (--window 2 <repo> --detach) is silently ignored; (c) tests' _run should put <home>/.local/bin first on PATH itself, so a mutant missing agents_up.sh:87's PATH export cannot fall through to the real tmux server; (d) ensure_overflow's kill-what-I-created path: run X kills a <S>+<k> run Y attached to if window agents-<k> vanishes between their checks (read, not executed); (e) stale_group_members returns nothing once <S> has any group, so a base that pre-fix code already dragged into an old group no longer reports its stale members (cosmetic); (f) _Scratch.close's socket guard has no pinned test, and a kill-server TimeoutExpired propagates from the finalizer. Wave-4 review (T05+T06) residue: (g) agents_bat.py --tabbed: a transient `agents_up.sh --print` timeout makes `_has_grid` read 'no grid', so that repo's tab drops from the tabbed file until the next run (pre-existing `_has_grid` behaviour); (h) per-repo agents_bat.py with a failing Deck resolver says "distro '' is not a WSL distro name" — cosmetic, the resolver prints its own failure note first. Wave-5 review (T08a) residue: (i) agents_spawn.py _clear_stale_group decides from one list-sessions snapshot, but a concurrent agents_up.sh writer can still group <S> between that snapshot and the leftover kill — closes only when agents_up.sh's grid writers take the same agents lock (fabrik-agents.lock); (j) with two leftover <S>+<digits> sessions, a failed second kill refuses after the first was cleared and the refusal names only the failing one (nothing is created; a re-run completes the clear).
